sections.Profile:
The "Auto Race" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in September 1956, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Wayne Neyens, with artwork by Roy Parker. The game features two flippers, four pop bumpers, two passive bumpers, two slingshots, three standup targets, and two gobble holes.
